## Context (top motifs)

### causality,assignment,inheritance,custodianship,judgment (sim=1.00)
Assignment is inherited, then redefined at the margin. The individual does not author the causal assignment; it takes over one already running, on a regular basis, and redefines it a little — from a higher-order vantage, but still using the same projection of reason. The world supplies co-occurrence; culture supplies the finished graph. 'I cannot get a doctor' is experienced; 'immigration is why' is received intact as a compiled assignment. The carrier contributes the marginal edit. This is Layer 0 custodianship applied to the act of assigning: agency awakens inside an already-moving system, which is why responsibility feels retroactive. Michotte: causal structure arrives through a compiled recogniser — fast, confident, no provenance — so the received assignment and the perceived one are not marked differently; takeover is invisible to the taker.

### sanction,conformity,judgment,closure (sim=1.00)
The fixed response is itself a compiled judgment: fast, cheap, categorical, no case-by-case evaluation, high confidence, no provenance — J1 at group scale, inheriting J1's failure exactly. The group cannot notice, from inside its rule, the case its rule does not cover. The response fires on the deviant who is right precisely as reliably as on the deviant who is wrong, because it keys on non-conformity, not on error. 'Black sheep' is the name a group has for the person currently supplying epistemic friction.


## Task
Explore the connection between [causality, assignment, inheritance, custodianship, judgment] and [manager, stewardship, regulation, coherence]. The field links them across threads (mem-framework x stewardship-model) although their vocabularies barely overlap. What higher abstraction binds them? State it, develop it, and end with one testable prediction.
response:
Marginal Custody — the binding abstraction.

The manager premise and the takeover correction are the same claim at two
scales. The manager does not author the organism; it assumes custody of a
running system and regulates at the margin. The causal reasoner does not
author its assignments; it takes over a compiled graph and redefines a
little, from one level up, with faculties the inheritance supplied.

Generalized: ALL GOVERNANCE IS MARGINAL EDITING OF INHERITED RUNTIME.
No governing function — manager, reasoner, group recogniser, institution —
ever starts its system; each awakens inside one already moving, which is
why responsibility is always retroactive and why authorship is the
characteristic illusion of every governing layer (fantasy autonomy at the
organism scale, perceived causation at the assignment scale).

The two failure modes of Layer 0 map exactly onto assignment: moralism is
blaming the carrier for the inherited graph; fantasy autonomy is the carrier
mistaking takeover for authorship. And the projection ceiling (revise the
rule, not the apparatus) is the invariant of provisional authority read
cognitively: custody is borrowed, and the terms of custody — what counts as
a reason — are part of what is borrowed.

Testable prediction: framing responsibility as custodial (you maintain and
may amend a running arrangement) versus authorial (you chose this) should
shift blame-attribution and repair behavior measurably — custodial framing
increasing willingness to revise inherited rules while decreasing punitive
response to inherited outcomes.
